To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) parents' involvement in research is associated with increased knowledge and awareness of their children's development; 2) parents' involvement is associated with increased awareness of the role of the home and family in the development of their young children; 3) parents' involvement increases parents' sense of empowerment and efficacy; 4) parents' involvement enhances the quality of parent-child interactions; and 5) parents' involvement contributes to the development of a more supportive and effective community-based intervention.
